heads.t: 公費接種流感及新冠疫苗開跑 陳福海籲鄉親踴躍接種 及早提升健康免疫力 2026/11/06 秋冬呼吸道傳染病防護不可輕忽，金門縣政府呼籲符合公費接種資格的鄉親，尤其是65歲以上長者及具有慢性病等高風險族群，儘早前往合約醫療院所，經醫師評估後完成流感及新冠疫苗接種，降低感染後發生重症及死亡的風險。金門縣衛生局同步推出疫苗接種抽獎活動，凡符合活動條件者於115年12月31日前在縣內合約院所完成接種，即有機會獲得實用家電及超商商品卡，鼓勵鄉親及早建立健康防護。…

議會定期會議案讀會 縣府34案、議員15案交付審查 2026/11/06 金門縣議會第八屆第八次定期會議案讀會於昨日上午9時30分在金門縣議會議事大廳舉行，由議長洪允典主持，縣議員出席與會，縣長陳福海率縣府各局處室的一級、二級主官列席。此次共計表決通過34項縣府提案以及15項議員提案，後續將交付給各審查委員小組進行分組審議。各提案之決議結果如下： 【縣府提案】 分組聯席：案1、審議金門縣116年度總預算案暨負數單位預算及綜計表。…

王國代主持第三審查委員會會議 2026/11/06 金門縣議會第八屆第八次定期會第三審查委員會分組審查會議於昨（5）日在第三小組審查委員會會議室召開，由小組召集人王國代主持，委員洪成發、李養生、許大鴻出席；城鄉發展處處長吳志偉、副處長陳彥志、科長商中治、李程遠、湯麗雲、主計處蔡台珍、黃婉芬等與會。會中審查通過縣府提案四案，說明如下： 案號1「審議金門縣116年度總預算案暨附屬單位預算及綜計表」，審查意見：1、城鄉發展處：照案通過。2、城鄉發展處主管：非營業部分（金門縣住宅基金）：照案通過。 案號16、17、18等案，審查意見均為「照案通過」。

來往馬來西亞 吉隆坡直航金門的雙向包機首發 2026/11/06 為持續拓展國際觀光客源，強化金門與東南亞地區的旅遊連結，由地區業者長伶國際旅行社有限公司主辦，金門縣政府提供包機獎助之「金門│馬來西亞吉隆坡直航雙向包機」，於昨（5）日正式首航。 縣府表示，本航線由馬來西亞峇迪航空執飛，首發航班共載送172位旅客自吉隆坡抵達金門，並有173位金門鄉親搭乘包機前往吉隆坡，再度為金門開拓東南亞客源市場及促進兩地觀光往來。 為迎接吉隆坡首航班機抵金，金門尚義機場特別安排「水門禮」迎賓儀式，由消防車噴灑水柱形成水拱門，為首航增添隆重氣氛。縣府觀光處也安排天震堂舞獅團帶迎賓表演。…
金湖鎮長陳文顧施政報告 盼代表會支持各項計畫 2026/11/06 金湖鎮民代表會第13屆第8次定期會於11月2日至13日召開，鎮長陳文顧於（3）日進行施政報告，針對基礎建設、觀光發展、社會福利、環境永續及基層治理等五大面向，說明115年度施政成果與各項建設推動進度，並回顧八年任內施政成果。 定期會由主席蔡乃靖主持，副主席李秀華及代表陳秀卿、蔡建偉、林麗芬、陳威彰、林嘉森、李志鴻出席與會。…
兩島同心 Two Isles, One Spirit 塔斯師生滿載金門情誼返程 2026/11/06 澳洲塔斯馬尼亞州29位師生結束在金門8天的教育與文化交流，4日由水頭碼頭搭船前往廈門，將再經香港返回澳洲。交流期間，澳洲學生走進各國中校園體驗在地特色課程，並由學伴家庭接待、體驗金門的日常生活；到訪期間更恰逢金門縣第25屆縣運會，塔斯師生的參與，也為今年縣運增添了不少光彩。…

從複利層面 談金大捐血活動義舉 2026/11/06 愛因斯坦曾說：「世界上最強大的力量是複利。」從某個層面言，捐血何嘗不是一種複利的良習？因為就社會學言，捐血是一種正向、健康，利己且利他的複利行為，值得推展力行。 複利的良習？首先是拯救生命與支持醫療運作，由於血液無法透過人工製造，因此外科手術、重大意外創傷、癌症化療、產科大出血，或慢性疾病患者，皆高度依賴社會大眾的愛心捐血，才能度過難關。進而維持醫療韌性，確保各大醫院在面臨急難救助或突發災難時，不至於陷入血荒，維持公共衛生與醫療系統的正常運作，衍為一種行善的社會良評。從身心言，自能帶給自身一種安慰、康健的心理。…

溫良守讓──五股守讓堂的故事 2026/11/06 新北市五股，多數人的印象，可能還停留在工業區、交流道……其實，依傍在觀音山下的五股，與大台北的歷史文化相依相連，也是一個相當有故事的地方。 五股，昔稱「五穀坑」，意思是物產豐饒之地，最早為凱達格蘭族的武朥灣社。到了十八世紀，淡水河新莊一帶的漢人，開始往八里方向移動，觀音山腳下的五股就成了墾拓之地。 五股有平地、丘陵和山地，可種稻米、果樹和茶葉，經過數十年的耕耘，稻米、茶葉和柑橘使五股風生水起。…

期中選舉後政策生變引爆拋售潮：美股全面重挫 費半暴跌逾12%創歷史性跌幅 美國股市週四遭遇猛烈拋售潮，各主要指數全線重挫，不僅回吐了前一日因期中選舉慶祝行情所帶來的全部漲幅，更創下數月乃至數年來的最差單日表現，由於市場極度擔憂全美資料中心建置進程可能放緩，投資人加速撤離科技與人工智慧（AI）相關資產，拋售壓力隨後蔓延至整個金融市場。 28 分鐘前｜國際 期中選舉後政策生變引爆拋售潮：美股全面重挫 費半暴跌逾12%創歷史性跌幅 28 分鐘前｜國際

heads.t: 立冬將至！超市土雞進補六鍋PK米其林羊肉爐 立冬將至，全台氣溫明顯下滑，各大業者紛紛搶攻冬令進補商機。從連鎖超市主打台灣在地桂丁土雞推出「冬補六鍋」料理，到連鎖日式壽司店首度跨界與拉麵品牌聯名推出熱湯系列，甚至超商業者也鎖定單身族群推出米其林名店聯名個人湯品，各家業者都希望以最便利的方式，讓民眾輕鬆享受冬季熱食。 1 小時前｜生活 立冬將至！超市土雞進補六鍋PK米其林羊肉爐 1 小時前｜生活
heads.en: The winter is coming! The supermarket chickens are coming in to fill six pots of PK-Miche's lamb furnaces, the winter is coming up, the weather is going down, and the majors are fighting for winter. From the launch of a "winter six pots" dish in the Quinotin pheasant by the owner of the supermarket chain to the launch of the hot soup series by the Japanese sushi store for the first time across the border and under the name of the ramen brand, even the supermarket has locked the single community into the launch of a personal soup by the name of the Mischilling Shop, with the desire of the various businesses to enjoy the winter hot meal in the most convenient way. An hour ago, the winter came!

heads.t: 台指期夜盤動盪！衝破4.2萬點後下滑 台積電期貨走弱 美國期中選舉後，市場對AI產業投資前景展開重新評估。美股週四（5日）盤前表現分歧，道瓊指數續漲，那斯達克及輝達、美光、英特爾、台積電ADR等科技股走弱。台股期貨夜盤雖一度成功重返4萬2千點大關，但十分動盪。美股方面，道瓊指數、那斯達克綜合指數、S&P(標普)500上漲，僅費城半導體下跌。 13 分鐘前｜財經 台指期夜盤動盪！衝破4.2萬點後下滑 台積電期貨走弱 13 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: After the mid-term election in the United States, the market began to re-evaluate the prospects for investment in the AI industry. The US shares show their differences before Thursday (5th) and Dow Jones's numbers continue to rise, and the technology units of Nasdaq and Heda, Migwang, Intel, and Radio ADR are weak. Even though the stock futures board had once succeeded in re-entering the 42,000 points level, it was very volatile. On the American stock side, Dow Jones, Nasdarq, S&P (Pop) up 500, only the Philadelphia semi-director fell. 13 minutes ago, the money was running at night!

heads.t: 行政院批藍營「普發2萬」要舉債 藍委揭數據反嗆：嚇唬人民？ 全民普發現金受到國人關注，對於國民黨要加強宣傳「票投國民黨普發3萬」，行政院於5日做出明確回應，直言若透過舉債來增加發放金額至2萬或3萬元，不但違反政府不增加實質舉債的原則，借來的款項最終仍需由全體國民承擔。對此，國民黨立法院黨團書記長許宇甄痛批，「行政院不要胡說八道！」國民黨團已將今年普發兩萬元的特別條例逕付二讀，財源主張清清楚楚，就是優先用115年度超徵稅收支應。政院拿假設的舉債情境嚇唬人民，請問有哪一筆帳證明普發兩萬非借錢不可？ 40 分鐘前｜政治 行政院批藍營「普發2萬」要舉債 藍委揭數據反嗆：嚇唬人民？ 40 分鐘前｜政治
heads.en: The government's "all-in-the-world 20,000" debt is being raised. When the general public discovered that Kim was receiving attention from the state, and that the National Democratic Party (NDP) was to be vehemently announced that "the vote was to be paid at 30,000", the Council of State responded definitively on 5th day, stating that if the debt was to be raised to 20,000 or 30,000 yuan, the loan would ultimately have to be borne by the entire nation, not only in contravention of the government's policy of not increasing the amount of debt. In response to this, the Secretary-General of the National Legislative Assembly of the National Party, Xu Woo, gave a heartening approval that "The Executive Council will not say anything!" The National Democratic Party has issued a special 20,000-dollar rule this year, and the financial owners have made it clear that the 115-year excess tax bill is the first priority. The council scares people with a hypothetical debt situation. 40 minutes ago, in the political arena, the Executive Council issued 20,000 dollars in debt. 40 minutes ago, politics.

heads.t: 人潮不等於錢潮！赤峰街老店撐不住租金 醫美、健身房成店面新寵 不論平日或假日，台北中山商圈總是人潮不斷，尤其赤峰街聚集老宅、咖啡店與特色小店，逐漸發展出獨特的文創風格。不過，隨著商圈知名度提升，店面租金也水漲船高，近期部分經營多年的特色店家陸續撤租，除了營運成本增加，高租金更成為業者難以承受的壓力。房仲業者指出，赤峰街店面租金10年來明顯上漲，熱門店面每坪月租甚至上看2萬元，商圈店面生態也隨之改變。 48 分鐘前｜財經 人潮不等於錢潮！赤峰街老店撐不住租金 醫美、健身房成店面新寵 48 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: The trend is not the same as the money tide! The old shop on Red Peak Street can't hold up the rents, the health, gym and the new shop, whether it's a day or a holiday, the Taipei Middle Mountain business circles are always on the rise, especially when Red Peak gathers the old house, coffee shop and specialty shop, and gradually develops a unique cultural style. However, with the increased visibility of the business community and the rise in market rents, some of the specialty stores that have been operating for many years recently have continued to withdraw their rents, which, in addition to higher operating costs, have become harder on the producers. According to housing operators, the rent on Red Peak Street has risen significantly over the past 10 years, with a monthly rent of even $20,000 on top of the hot shop and a change in the way in which businesses operate. 48 minutes ago, the money was not the same as the money!

heads.t: 基本工資連11年調漲 小吃業苦撐：快請不起人 最低工資明年跨過3萬元，直接受到衝擊的，是薪資結構較貼近最低工資、且大量使用基層或時薪人力的住宿餐飲業、民生服務業等。調薪後增加的不只是最低工資本身，也會牽動勞健保、加班費等人事成本，也可能加劇內部「薪資壓縮」問題。商總建議，提高基層薪資是公共政策，不能只叫獲利相對低的產業買單，政府也該多扛一點。 48 分鐘前｜財經 基本工資連11年調漲 小吃業苦撐：快請不起人 48 分鐘前｜財經
heads.en: The basic wage has been rising for 11 years, and the small-eat industry has been struggling: it is hard to afford people, and the minimum wage will be over $30,000 next year, and it will be directly affected by a salary structure that is closer to the minimum wage, a residential catering industry that uses much of the base or hourly manpower, a domestic service industry, etc. The increase in wages is not only due to the minimum wage per se, but also to staff costs such as health insurance, overtime, etc., and may add to the problem of "restriction of pay". It is suggested that raising the base salary is a public policy and that the government should not simply pay for less profitable businesses, but that the government should pay more. 48 minutes ago, the basic wage went up 11 years ago.

heads.t: 關稅議題+景氣低迷夾擊！車廠祭「3策略」搶年終買氣 台灣車市今年面臨多重挑戰，包括國際關稅政策不明朗、各行業景氣低迷，以及消費者觀望情緒濃厚，導致買氣持續疲軟。各大車廠紛紛預估全年市場規模將下修，和泰車將預估從44萬台調降至43萬台，裕日車更保守估計僅約41.5萬台。面對市場壓力，車廠積極推出改款新車、升級配備並搭配促銷方案，全力搶攻年終買氣。 48 分鐘前｜生活 關稅議題+景氣低迷夾擊！車廠祭「3策略」搶年終買氣 48 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: The city of Taiwan faced multiple challenges this year, including unclear international tax policies, a low level of industry, and strong consumer expectations. It is estimated that the size of the market will be reduced throughout the year, and that the number of taxis will be reduced from 440,000 to 430,000, with a more conservative estimate of only about 415,000. In the face of market pressure, the garage has been actively promoting new cars, upgrades, and matching marketing programmes, all of which are dedicated to the end of the year. Forty-eight minutes ago, life was on the line. The 3rd Strategy ceremony ended up buying gas 48 minutes ago.

heads.t: 有運動仍要防久坐！醫揭血管健康風險 每30分鐘起身走動！ 根據國民健康署調查，台灣18歲以上的成年人，將近一半，身體活動不足，平均每天坐著約 6 小時。澳洲一項追蹤超過22萬人的研究發現，每天坐11小時以上的人，死亡風險是坐不到， 4 小時以上的人1.4倍。 48 分鐘前｜健康 有運動仍要防久坐！醫揭血管健康風險 每30分鐘起身走動！ 48 分鐘前｜健康
heads.en: There's a movement that needs to be protected from long sittings! According to a survey conducted by the National Department of Human Health, almost half of Taiwan's 18-year-old adults will be under-activated, on average, for about six hours a day. A study in Australia that tracks more than 220,000 people found that people who sit for more than 11 hours a day are less likely to die, 1.4 times more than four hours. 48 minutes ago, in health, there was still a sport to sit on! Medically exposed vascular health risks.

heads.t: 減法生活正夯！斷捨離不只清空間 連人際、理財都能「去蕪存菁」 現代人生活步調緊湊，居家空間與心理狀態常在不知不覺間被滿滿的雜物與壓力佔據。近年來「減法生活」成為顯學，透過居家斷捨離不僅能清空實體環境，更能療癒身心，這套捨棄不必要事物的哲學，甚至能延伸到人際關係與財務規劃，幫助人們緩解盲目跟風的焦慮，重新拿回人生的主導權。 48 分鐘前｜生活 減法生活正夯！斷捨離不只清空間 連人際、理財都能「去蕪存菁」 48 分鐘前｜生活
heads.en: Demolition of life is a reality! To leave more than just empty space, even humans and financials can “go to save” modern life is being tightened, and living space and mental state are often unwittingly filled with groceries and stress. In recent years, "reducing life" has become an example of a philosophy that, by leaving homes, not only clears the physical environment, but also heals the body and the body. This philosophy of abandoning unnecessary things can extend even to human relations and financial planning, helping people to ease the anxiety of blindness and wind and regain their primary responsibility for life. 48 minutes ago, life was reduced, life was reduced!

heads.t: 女兒遭父親「薑罰」！網一查全炸鍋：根本性虐待 面對小孩對於課業的不上心，父母難免氣惱，做出懲罰。不過近日，就有一位媽媽透露女兒因段考成績不理想，遭到丈夫以藤條毆打及名為「薑罰」的方式管教。貼文曝光後引爆社會關注，直言「薑罰」涉及嚴重性虐待與性侵嫌疑。對此，社團管理團隊緊急出手封存後台資料，並依法向113保護專線及警政、社政單位主動通報；衛福部也已針對此案作出回應、介入調查。 1 小時前｜生活 女兒遭父親「薑罰」！網一查全炸鍋：根本性虐待 1 小時前｜生活
heads.en: The daughter was "punished" by her father! In recent days, however, a mother who had revealed that her daughter had been disciplined by her husband in the form of a stabbing and a "punishment" in the name of Fujiko. The post blew up social concerns after the post was posted, stating that "punishment" involved serious sexual abuse and suspected sexual assault. In response, the group's management team immediately sealed the background data and, in accordance with the law, informed the 113 protection line and the police and social services; the Ministry of Defence and Welfare responded and intervened in the investigation. An hour ago, the daughter was punished by his father!

heads.t: 台中野餐日12/6登場 踩點打卡抽「日本機票」 第5屆台中市民野餐日將於12月6日登場，今年以「走進草地、走近生活」為主題，活動地點擴大至全市29個行政區共58個公園，主打「家門口就能野餐」的概念，讓民眾帶著毛小孩與親朋好友，輕鬆坐在公園草地上享受悠閒時光。 1 小時前｜生活 台中野餐日12/6登場 踩點打卡抽「日本機票」 1 小時前｜生活

One hour ago, the Chinese picnic ended 12/6.

heads.t: 新北拆6座攔水堰 生態友善工法助魚蝦洄游 新北市水利局近期改變傳統水利工程做法，拆除河道上6座攔水堰並整修1100多公尺護岸，以生態友善工法兼顧防洪與生態保育，成功讓原生物種數量回升，甚至記錄到保育類穿山甲與白鼻心出沒，該工程更榮獲國家卓越建設獎等多項大獎肯定。 1 小時前｜生活 新北拆6座攔水堰 生態友善工法助魚蝦洄游 1 小時前｜生活

An hour ago, we had a life in New North.
